requirement_et: Rakenduse kood on versioneeritud kasutades Git'i.
evidence: Git repository; pinned main commit; drizzle/ migrations and migration tests.
gap_and_next_action: Retain complete history and migration artifacts in the receiving organisation.

requirement_et: Rakenduse lähtekood on kirjutatud selgusega, mis võimaldab erialast ettevalmistust omaval tarkvaraarendajal süsteemi edasi arendada.
evidence: src/domain/allocate.ts; src/server/rounds/engine.ts; docs/tehniline-ulevaade.md; rule-linked tests.
gap_and_next_action: Strong domain separation and comments. Split the growing engine/framework modules by lifecycle when next changing them; keep specifications current.

requirement_en: Publish reusable code in e-gov repository
requirement_et: Taaskasutatavalt disainitud rakenduse kood on e-riigi koodivaramus (koodivaramu.eesti.ee).
evidence: Source is on GitHub; no e-gov mirror is documented.
gap_and_next_action: Agree licence and mirror to koodivaramu where reuse is intended.

requirement_en: Build without external dependencies being available
requirement_et: Rakenduste ehitamine pole väliselt sõltuv.
evidence: Dockerfile; pnpm-lock.yaml; .github/workflows/ci.yml fetch public packages/images/actions.
gap_and_next_action: Provide agency-controlled source, package and base-image mirrors; demonstrate a disconnected build. Lockfiles alone are insufficient.

requirement_en: Use a TIOBE top-25 programming language
requirement_et: Rakenduse arenduses ei kasutata programmeerimiskeeli, mis pole Top 25 TIOBE index'is.
evidence: TypeScript source; TIOBE September 2026 lists TypeScript at 39; JavaScript is within top 25.
gap_and_next_action: Literal source-language mismatch. Seek an explicit TypeScript exception supported by recruitment and maintenance evidence; this is not a reason to rewrite the application.

requirement_et: Rakenduse tarkvara markeerida litsentsiga.
evidence: No LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING file, package licence or general source licence headers found. basic-secret-license-scan.json.
gap_and_next_action: Owner must establish rights and select a suitable licence; include third-party notices. A public GitHub repository is not a licence.

requirement_en: Component end of life at least five years away
requirement_et: Kõikide arendamisel kasutatavate komponentide (rakenduse, andmebaasi, kolmanda osapoole omad) eluea lõpp (inglise k End-of-Life, EOL) ei tohi teadaolevalt olla vähem kui 5 aastat.
evidence: Dockerfile and CI use Node 22; official Node schedule gives EOL 2027-04-30.
gap_and_next_action: Document supported component inventory and funded upgrades; agree how the literal five-year requirement is satisfied or excepted. The current runtime expires before framework end in December 2027.

requirement_et: Teenuse rakendustele eksisteerivad ajakohased taasteplaanid.
evidence: docs/juurutamine.md §7 has consistent SQLite backup and restore instructions; standalone restart test passed.
gap_and_next_action: Assign RPO/RTO, backup ownership, encryption and retention; execute a restore from independent backup. A process restart is not a backup recovery drill.

requirement_et: Rakendus peab olema läbinud enne toodangusse minemist turvatestimise.
evidence: Authentication tests and this independent review exist; no completed formal risk-based preproduction security assessment found.
gap_and_next_action: Commission and accept a scoped assessment after fixes, including deployed proxy/identity, authorization, uploads and incident controls.

requirement_en: No known vulnerabilities at production release without accepted exception
requirement_et: Rakendus ei lähe toodangu-keskkonda, kui selles on avastatud turvalisuse nõrkuseid ja/või haavatavusi.
evidence: Reproduced authorization/business-state weaknesses; dependency-audit.json reports 3 high and 9 moderate affected-package entries.
gap_and_next_action: Fix confirmed weaknesses, triage advisory reachability, patch applicable dependencies, scan image, and record any approved risk exceptions before production.

requirement_et: Toodangusse ei lähe kood, mis pole läbinud koodi ülevaatamist (code review) minimaalselt nelja-silma printsiibi põhimõttel.
evidence: Git history contains pull-request merges; repository protection and human approvals were not verified.
gap_and_next_action: Require independent human review and protected release branches; a merge commit alone does not establish four-eyes review.

requirement_et: Toodangu-keskkonda ei lähe kood, mille testid ebaõnnestuvad.
evidence: CI passes typecheck, 591 tests and build; deploy.yml runs separately on push and depends only on bootstrap.
gap_and_next_action: Make production deployment depend on successful checks for the same commit/artifact. Current Fly workflow targets test, so no failed production deployment is alleged.

requirement_et: Keskkondadesse tarkvara paigaldamine on automatiseeritud.
evidence: Dockerfile, fly.toml and deploy.yml automate the test environment; government topology is described in docs/juurutamine.md.
gap_and_next_action: Deliver reviewed, reproducible manifests/pipeline for the actual government environment and its rollback procedure.

requirement_et: Rakenduse tarne toodangu-keskkonda toimub sinine-roheline põhimõttel, ehk rakendusest sõltuva teenuse töö ei katke versiooniuuenduse puhul.
evidence: docs/juurutamine.md specifies one instance and Recreate; SQLite file has a single application owner.
gap_and_next_action: Agree planned outage as an exception, or redesign persistence/jobs and prove safe blue-green operation if zero downtime is required.

requirement_et: Rakendus on versioneeritud kasutades semantilise versioneerimise põhimõtet.
evidence: package.json is 0.1.0; specification is v2.7; protocol schema and allocation algorithm have separate versions.
gap_and_next_action: Define release tags, changelog and compatibility policy. Distinguish app, specification, schema and algorithm versions.

requirement_et: Toodangu keskkondades on rakendused on automaatselt monitooritud.
evidence: /api/health and Fly health checks; operator documentation names log/health/disk alerts.
gap_and_next_action: Provide configured alerts with recipients and exercises, including overdue round closures, aged queued/failed mail, backup age and disk pressure.

requirement_et: Rakenduse tehnilised komponendid logivad korrelatsiooni ID'd või genereerivad selle ise. Korrelatsiooni ID'd saadetakse iga edasise päringuga kaasa.
evidence: No request correlation-ID propagation or consistent structured logging found in src/server or app routes.
gap_and_next_action: Draft only: introduce request/event identifiers when central logging is implemented.

requirement_en: Authenticate through TARA unless explicitly justified
requirement_et: Kasutajate autentimine käib läbi RIA TARA.
evidence: src/server/auth/codes.ts implements email OTP; docs/juurutamine.md §9 treats TARA as future work.
gap_and_next_action: Use TARA/GovSSO or obtain a documented, approved exception. Map verified identities to independently maintained company representation. Source level is literally kohustus.

requirement_et: Rakenduse tehnilised komponendid kaitsevad iseennast ja valideerivad nende poole pöördunud kasutaja või tehnilise teenuse õiguseid.
evidence: Central buyerWrite/adminWrite/partnerWrite guards; browser-mutations-confirmed.json reproduces cross-partner markNotificationReadAction mutation.
gap_and_next_action: Constrain every object mutation to the authenticated subject and recipient; test direct Server Action requests across roles and organisations.

requirement_et: Tehniliste komponentide API'del eksisteerib automaatselt genereeritud dokumentatsioon.
evidence: Next Server Actions and file/health routes; no generated OpenAPI or equivalent contract found.
gap_and_next_action: Document reusable service contracts and generate API documentation where integrations are exposed. Agree scope for framework-internal actions.

requirement_et: Rakendused on disainitud ja arendatud domeenist juhinduva disaini (domain driven design) ja mikroteenuste arhitektuuri põhimõtteid jälgides.
evidence: Pure domain layer and clear domain concepts; deployed as one Next process and SQLite database.
gap_and_next_action: Domain design is present; autonomous microservices are absent. Seek a justified modular-monolith exception for this small workload before considering service extraction.

requirement_et: Infosüsteemide vaheline andmevahetus toimub üle X-tee.
evidence: No runtime registry or other business-system integration; only SMTP and manual workbook transfer currently.
gap_and_next_action: Reassess if RHR, registries, document management or other government-system integration enters scope. No reason to add an unused X-tee connection.

requirement_en: Separate UI and reusable service layer via API
requirement_et: Kasutajaliides ja teenuse funktsionaalsus on loogiliselt eristatud kihid ja suhtlevad üle API. Äriloogilised tehnilised komponendid on kasutatavad erinevate kasutajaliideste poolt.
evidence: src/domain, src/server and src/app separate responsibilities; Next Server Actions bind interfaces to the web application.
gap_and_next_action: Retain domain separation; expose stable service APIs where a second UI or external consumer is required, or agree the limited reuse scope.

requirement_et: Tehnilised komponendid avaldavad taaskasutuseks REST API
evidence: /api/health exists; procurement operations use Next Server Actions, not a versioned reusable REST API.
gap_and_next_action: Define required integration/export endpoints, authorization and semantics; add REST contracts or obtain a scoped exception.

requirement_en: Client UI state and stateless services
requirement_et: Kasutajaliidese olekut (state) hoitakse kliendi liidese poolel ja teenused on ise olekuta.
evidence: Client components hold form state; sessions, drafts and business records persist in SQLite; in-process jobs and mail outbox remain.
gap_and_next_action: Document which state is durable domain data versus UI state; remove instance-local dispatch reliance before adding replicas.

requirement_en: Cloud suitability including replicas and scaling
requirement_et: Rakendus on pilvekõlbulik.
evidence: Container, environment configuration and persistent volume exist. Deployment explicitly requires exactly one instance, no scale-to-zero and Recreate.
gap_and_next_action: Does not satisfy the stated multi-instance/autoscaling/two-site requirements. Agree availability exception or move to shared managed persistence plus safe distributed job/queue coordination.

requirement_en: Distributed components do not share database or filesystem
requirement_et: Rakenduse tehnilised hajuskomponendid ei jaga sama andmebaasi, mälu ega failisüsteemi.
evidence: One deployable application owns its database; there are no separately deployed business services sharing storage.
gap_and_next_action: Keep ownership boundaries explicit if services are later extracted; a monolith having one database is not itself a violation of this conditional rule.

requirement_en: Configuration and secrets injected through environment
requirement_et: Rakenduse konfiguratsioon (sh. paroolid) ei ole osa tarkvara koodist vaid paigaldatakse külge rakenduse tarnel keskkonda läbi keskkonnamuutujate.
evidence: src/lib/env.ts validates environment; Docker and deployment documentation use externally supplied secrets.
gap_and_next_action: Keep live secrets in the receiving platform secret store; harden production startup validation for unsafe or missing settings.

requirement_en: No business logic in database triggers/procedures
requirement_et: Andmebaas ei tohi sisaldada äriloogikat (triggerid, protseduurid jms).
evidence: Allocation and state transitions are TypeScript; drizzle triggers enforce append-only records and database integrity.
gap_and_next_action: Integrity constraints are not allocation business logic. Ask the receiving architect to confirm this interpretation if any trigger is disallowed literally.

requirement_en: Reuse existing national or OS identity system
requirement_et: Rakendus ei tohi luua uut identiteedisüsteemi. Tuleb tugineda olemasolevatele riiklikele (ID-kaart) või põhiliste op-süsteemide süsteemidele (Kerberos jms).
evidence: Custom users, representatives, login_codes and sessions, with mailbox possession as authentication.
gap_and_next_action: Integrate the accepted identity provider; application-specific roles/representation may remain in the application.

requirement_et: Tehnilised komponendid peavad saatma tehnilise XML manifesti RIHA X'i
evidence: Source explicitly marks this requirement deprecated.
gap_and_next_action: Excluded from active assessment; do not implement the deprecated manifest requirement.

requirement_en: Explicit documented user stories / functional scope
requirement_et: Süsteemi funktsionaalne skoop on defineeritud ja dokumenteeritud selgesõnaliste kasutuslugudega. Nimetatud kasutuslood peavad olema toote ärilises dokumentatsioonis.
evidence: docs/kaskaadi-ariloogika.md has 96 identified rules and worked examples; user guide and role/lifecycle descriptions.
gap_and_next_action: Strong functional scope. Reconcile stale order-issuance wording with L-25 and resolve listed open business decisions.

requirement_et: Kasutajafunktsionaalsus peab olema kaetud automaattestidega.
evidence: 591 tests and auth/e2e/admin/protocol suites pass locally; direct-action probes exposed missed negative paths.
gap_and_next_action: Run browser acceptance in release CI; add risk-based object authorization, timing and interrupted-mail scenarios. Passing happy paths are not complete coverage.

requirement_en: Load testing at twice expected users before production
requirement_et: Rakendused on läbinud koormustestid vähemalt kahekordse eeldatava kasutajamahuga enne toodangusse minekut.
evidence: docs/juurutamine.md estimates tens of partners and hundreds of annual rounds; no 2x load-test evidence or explicit peak target found.
gap_and_next_action: Agree simultaneous users, uploads and deadline bursts; test at least 2x peak, including slow SMTP and concurrent SQLite writes.

requirement_en: Unit tests for complex internal functions
requirement_et: Keerulisemad sisemised tarkvaralised funktsioonid on kaetud unit-testidega.
evidence: 31 test files, 591 passing tests under Node 22; allocation, calendars, engine, migrations, imports, documents and authentication covered.
gap_and_next_action: Preserve tests and add independent edge-case tests for the reproduced defects. Test count is not proof that every rule is correct.

requirement_et: Kasutajaliides kasutab Riigi Infosüsteemide Amet'i pakutavat e-riigi stiiliraamatut.
evidence: src/app/globals.css and custom kh-* UI implement a bespoke dark theme; no RIA design-system adoption documented.
gap_and_next_action: Agree agency design-system requirements and apply approved components/style or document exception.

requirement_et: Rakendus peab töötama veebisirvijates, mis toetavad eID baastarkvara kaht viimast versiooni.
evidence: Chromium/Chrome suites passed; no evidence for the required supported browser/version matrix.
gap_and_next_action: Validate current officially supported eID browsers and versions, including keyboard and assistive technology combinations.

requirement_et: Veebipõhine kasutajaliides järgib HTML5 ja CSS3 standardeid.
evidence: Modern semantic HTML/React and CSS/Tailwind; rendered pages work in Chrome.
gap_and_next_action: Run standards validation and cross-browser checks; functional Chrome tests do not establish full standards conformance.

requirement_et: Rakendus vastab WCAG 2.1 AA tasemele
evidence: axe 4.13 scans: primary buttons 2.53:1 contrast, colour-only links, unlabelled file input; sample PDF is untagged and has no language metadata.
gap_and_next_action: Fix confirmed web failures, review PDF accessibility, and complete manual keyboard/screen-reader/zoom assessment plus accessibility statement. CFR says recommended; public-service accessibility obligations exist separately.

requirement_et: Tarkvara koodile rakendatakse staatilise koodi analüüsi.
evidence: Strict TypeScript check runs in CI; lint command prompts to configure missing ESLint and exits unsuccessfully noninteractively.
gap_and_next_action: Keep compiler checks; configure noninteractive lint/security analysis and actionable CI gates.

requirement_en: Operational logging and audit stored outside app/database
requirement_et: Rakenduse tarkvara tööd logitakse ning audit-logi talletatakse rakendusest ning selle baasist eraldi.
evidence: src/server/audit.ts writes audit_events in the same SQLite transaction/database; stdout operational logs do not export that full audit trail.
gap_and_next_action: Ship auditable events to independently protected storage; define retention, access auditing, delivery failure handling and incident retrieval. Preserve transactional local logging.

requirement_en: No personal data or session secrets in URLs
requirement_et: URL ei tohi sisaldada isikuandmeid või sessioonivõtit.
evidence: src/server/actions/auth.ts:116 redirects to /sisene/kood?e=<email>.
gap_and_next_action: Replace email in query parameters with an opaque challenge reference or server-side flow state; redact historical access logs according to policy.

requirement_en: Baseline ISKE K2T2S2 unless specified otherwise
requirement_et: Kui ei ole määratud teisiti, peab rakendus olema kasutatav ISKE klassile K2T2S2 vastavate süsteemide loomisel.
evidence: No approved information classification, control mapping or security assessment found. CFR contains legacy ISKE terminology.
gap_and_next_action: Agency security owner must determine current E-ITS obligations, classification and controls. Do not equate compliance with this old CFR file to current E-ITS compliance.

requirement_et: Kasutaja ja rakenduste (sealhulgas ka enda omade) sisendit kontrollitakse ja puhastatakse rakenduse poolel vastu rakenduse enda siseseid ootuseid.
evidence: Zod environment parsing, typed import-row validators and many engine guards; missing early-close deadline invariant and notification ownership check.
gap_and_next_action: Enforce invariants at the server domain boundary; reject malformed caps, and bound workbook expansion/row counts and strings, with abuse tests.

requirement_et: Rakenduse väljundit tuleb alati puhastada ja filtreerida enne kasutamist.
evidence: React escapes ordinary text; domain HTML templates escape inserted values; PDF denies external resource access.
gap_and_next_action: Positive implementation evidence, but no exhaustive stored-XSS, spreadsheet-formula and every-output sink assessment. Include those in security testing.

requirement_et: Kasutada ajakohaseid krüptoalgoritme
evidence: CSPRNG session tokens, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256 and timing-safe comparison in auth; protocol integrity comparison is incomplete.
gap_and_next_action: Validate algorithms, key lengths, TLS settings and lifecycle against latest RIA guidance; correct protocol trust check and document tested session revocation.

requirement_en: TLS between user interfaces and components, including internal networks
requirement_et: Kasutajaliides ja tehnilised komponendid suhtlevad üle TLS/SSL'i
evidence: Deployment guide requires edge TLS/HSTS but shows proxy-to-application HTTP; local server tested over HTTP.
gap_and_next_action: Verify actual government end-to-end TLS topology, including internal hops or approved exception. Local HTTP test is not evidence about public endpoint TLS.

requirement_et: Rakenduse tehnilised komponendid suhtlevad omavahel üle TLS/SSL'i
evidence: SMTP supports implicit TLS and required STARTTLS, but flags default off; internal application HTTP is documented.
gap_and_next_action: Enforce approved TLS settings at production startup and platform; verify certificates and relay/proxy connections in deployed environment.

requirement_et: Andmete kustutamine ei tohi kustutada tegelikke kirjeid andmebaasist, välja arvatud, kui kirjed pole mittefunktsionaalsed, ehk ei oma ärilist seost.
evidence: Deactivation/cancellation and append-only confirmations/audit preserve history; engine.ts replaces draft round_trainings with physical deletion.
gap_and_next_action: Define record retention and which transient draft associations may be physically replaced; test that all required historical business states remain reconstructable.

requirement_et: Andmed peavad olema talletatud vähemalt UTF-8 enkoodingus.
evidence: SQLite text and UTF-8 import/export paths; Estonian text exercised in unit/browser tests.
gap_and_next_action: Preserve Unicode end-to-end. Standard-font PDF transliteration is a separate display limitation, not proof of non-UTF-8 database storage.

requirement_et: Aja esitamisel tekstikujul lähtuda standardist ISO 8601.
evidence: Calendar data uses ISO day strings; instants stored as epoch milliseconds; Tallinn human-facing formatting explicit.
gap_and_next_action: Keep timezone semantics in exported schema. Localised UI dates are explicitly allowed by the CFR notes.

requirement_en: National registry identifiers and country prefixes
requirement_et: Objektid identifitseerida registrikoodide abil.
evidence: partners.reg_code exists; users/representatives are identified through email; no country-qualified verified personal ID.
gap_and_next_action: With identity integration, define national/foreign subject identifiers and representation mapping; qualify registry codes as required or document bounded scope.

requirement_et: Rakendada aadressiandmete süsteemi nõudeid.
evidence: trainings.county and location_text; free text can contain Estonian physical addresses; no ADS identifier/integration.
gap_and_next_action: Determine which location values are addresses versus venue descriptions. Use official address data where applicable; document online-only/unspecified-location exceptions.

requirement_en: Classification system / EMTAK for economic activities
requirement_et: Rakendada klassifikaatorite süsteemi nõudeid.
evidence: No economic-activity field or EMTAK use in the reviewed data model.
gap_and_next_action: Reassess if economic activity is added. Other classifier use is assessed separately in #61.

requirement_en: Version all records containing integrity-class-2+ data
requirement_et: Kui andmebaasis olevate andmete ISKE tervikluse klass on 2 või kõrgem, siis tuleb kõik klass 2 infot sisaldavad andmebaasi kirjed versioneerida.
evidence: Publication/allocation snapshots and append-only confirmations/audit exist; many entity rows change in place; protocol rows are mutable.
gap_and_next_action: Assuming default T2, define all in-scope records and provide complete version history. Audit summaries and selected snapshots alone do not establish universal record versioning. Confirm classification with owner.

requirement_et: Kasutatakse Riigi Infosüsteemide Ameti andmejälgijat.
evidence: No Andmejälgija interface or integration found; local audit UI is a different capability.
gap_and_next_action: Determine applicability with the data controller and implement approved tracking integration or document exception.

requirement_en: Publish state information-system data descriptions in RIHA
requirement_et: Riigi infosüsteemi kuuluvate andmekogude andmekirjeldused on avalikustatud RIHAs.
evidence: No RIHA listing, JSON manifest or registration evidence supplied. Public register status/application boundary is not established by code.
gap_and_next_action: Identify the responsible data collection/system, confirm RIHA obligation and publish/associate required descriptions. Do not infer that this tool must be a separate register.

requirement_en: Dataset, data-element descriptions and data dictionary
requirement_et: Infosüsteemile on koostatud andmekirjeldus.
evidence: Commented schema, technical overview, workbook field descriptions and business glossary exist.
gap_and_next_action: Create governed dataset/element definitions with meaning, ownership, identifiers, constraints and retention; export in the receiving catalogue format.

requirement_en: Data quality model and measurable indicators
requirement_et: Infosüsteemile saab rakendada andmekvaliteedi mudelit.
evidence: Validation/uniqueness rules address some correctness and conformity; no explicit five-dimension quality model or measurement specification.
gap_and_next_action: Define relevant completeness, timeliness, accuracy, conformity and uniqueness indicators and ownership at field/dataset level.

requirement_et: Infosüsteemist saab kvaliteedi mõõtmise tulemusi välja võtta.
evidence: No stored quality-measurement runs or indicator-result export found.
gap_and_next_action: Implement export of the agreed #59 indicators, their units, scope and measurement timestamps; retain results per policy.

requirement_et: Infosüsteem peab olema liidestatud ja kasutama klassifikaatorite haldajate poolt kehtestatud klassifikaatoreid.
evidence: COUNTIES and other enumerations are static source constants; no maintained classifier integration/versioning found.
gap_and_next_action: Inventory genuine official classifiers versus app-specific statuses; source official values and validity periods through a maintained integration.

requirement_en: Human- and machine-readable export with semantics
requirement_et: Andmeid saab eksportida masin- ja inimloetavas vormingus.
evidence: PDF protocol and structured XLSX exports exist; canonical protocol JSON stays internal; complete documented machine export is absent.
gap_and_next_action: Define export scope and semantics, including decisions/evidence and personal-data filtering. Add stable JSON/CSV/XML export where required; XLSX is structured but current coverage is incomplete.

requirement_en: No secrets in source or web documents
requirement_et: Võtmeid, sertifikaate, salasõnu ja muud sensitiivset ei talletata koodihoidlas või veebidokumentides.
evidence: Configuration uses env; current tracked-file basic key/token scan found no live-looking key material; .env.example is a template.
gap_and_next_action: Scoped result only: does not certify git history, deployed secrets or access controls. Run managed secret scanning and verify platform secret storage at handover.

requirement_et: Rakendus peab olema väliste süsteemide tõrgete suhtes vastupanuvõimeline (resilient).
evidence: Business transactions commit before SMTP and failed deliveries retry; stranded queued-mail probe reproduced; requests await sequential dispatch.
gap_and_next_action: Use a durable worker that recovers queued/interrupted sends, with claims, retry/backoff and backlog alerts; isolate request latency from relay timeouts.

requirement_et: Arenduse käigus luua WAF reeglid.
evidence: No application-specific WAF rules supplied.
gap_and_next_action: Draft only: include platform WAF decisions in threat modelling; do not treat this as an active mandatory CFR failure.

requirement_en: Attribute every action to a person
requirement_et: Kõik tegevused peavad olema isikustatud.
evidence: User/action audit and act-as attribution exist; background jobs use system actors; notification read changes are not fully attributed.
gap_and_next_action: Draft only: clarify system versus human actions and complete required audit coverage.

requirement_en: Administrative MFA when MFA is used
requirement_et: Kui kasutatakse mitmefaktorilist autentimist, siis sama kohustus on ka administratiivsetele funktsioonidele.
evidence: Application does not currently use MFA; email OTP is a single factor.
gap_and_next_action: Draft and conditional. Apply equal or stronger administrator assurance when national identity/MFA is introduced.
